description: Use this when the user asks which Charmotion account is connected, which plan it has, or how many credits they have left this period (one balance for character animations, AI designs and logo animations). Returns the account email, the plan name, the credits left, what each thing costs and when the period ends. Logo animation concepts don't use any of it. Read-only. Requires a linked Charmotion account.
name: get_account

credits_remaining.description: Credits left (one balance for everything: a character animation costs 1, an AI design 1, a logo animation 5; idle is free).

free_try.description: The one free character animation of an account without a plan.

period_end.description: When the current paid period ends (null on the free plan).

plan.description: Plan name, e.g. Free, Starter or All in one.

title: Get Charmotion account
